files.summary: Checks that every retained row of each policy-required shard of a passing SIM-4.2 certificate carries an Ed25519 signature valid under its externally admitted public key, binding the child, policy, subject, shard, step, time and state.
files.limits: Establishes only the registered proposition over externally selected finite inputs. Its registered exclusions include: unrequired shards, independent origin, key custody or signer authority; signature freshness, live key revocation, anti-equivocation or actual execution; cryptographic backend correctness, physical or dimensional truth; 3 further registered exclusions are listed in registration().

files.summary: Checks that an external finite map bijects every root state variable with every retained shard field of a passing SIM-4.3 child, preserves canonical values at every aligned time, and attributes each mapped transition to its replayed root transition expression.
files.limits: Establishes only the registered proposition over externally selected finite inputs. Its registered exclusions include: hidden process memory, physical reality and unretained states; nonlinear projections and entropy, action or observation channel completeness; signatures beyond the child's selected required-shard policy; 3 further registered exclusions are listed in registration().

files.summary: Registers SPACE-4.1 and replays the selected SPACE-3.1 child before checking gapless half-open logical byte partitions across the complete declared extent.
files.limits: Logical retained byte coverage only. Registered exclusions: actual host, device, storage or network allocation; physical containment, isolation or non-leakage; whole SPACE closure tier or object-profile conformance; privacy, consent, governance, security, spending or publication.

files.summary: Checks SPACE-3.1 for a selected SPACE record in an admitted finite collection: retained logical-byte partitions must be nonempty and hash-bound, have unique bounded identifiers, use positive power-of-two alignment, start on that alignment, stay within a nonempty declared extent, and form nonoverlapping half-open intervals. Missing partitions or capacity give UNKNOWN; alignment, commitment or overlap violations give FAIL.
files.limits: Registered exclusions: actual memory, storage, network or hardware allocation; physical containment, access control or isolation; coverage of unallocated gaps or scheduling authority; whole SPACE statics tier or object-profile conformance; privacy, consent, governance and security admission.

files.summary: Checks that before and after SPACE-3.1 children both replay PASS and that the retained migration map is a bijection from before-layout logical byte partitions onto after-layout partitions, each mapped partition starting at the declared offset with the same byte length.
files.limits: Establishes only the registered proposition over externally selected finite inputs. Its registered exclusions include: actual host, device or storage allocation, copying or data movement; routing tables, address translation hardware or physical containment; isolation, non-leakage or retention of partition contents; 2 further registered exclusions are listed in registration().

files.summary: Defines selected spacetime execution obligations and their exact current-object route metadata.
files.limits: The contract does not establish physical truth, complete temporal coverage, deployment safety, or release authority.

files.summary: Defines selected spacetime mapping obligations and exact structural bindings.
files.limits: Mapping validity is bounded to selected inputs and does not establish observational truth or exhaustive applicability.

files.summary: Defines finite spacetime profiles consumed by the selected mapping and execution contracts.
files.limits: Profiles are implementation inputs, not evidence of model correctness, physical completeness, or release readiness.

files.summary: Specifies the typed-subject receipt binding <kind>-9.1 (RECEIPT-9.3 for RECEIPT): the exact subject namespace record is the sole direct subject of a selected RECEIPT record, and the selected entry of its natively replayed finite chain equals the canonical typed-subject intent binding record, objective, receipt, domain, genesis, position, context and policy.
files.limits: Registered exclusions: issuer authenticity or digital-signature validity; payload truth, actual execution or enforcement; freshness or one-time consumption of context; typed-composition closure or hardware authenticity; privacy, consent, governance or public disclosure authority; complete security tier or object-profile conformance.

files.summary: Implements TIME-4.1 over a freshly replayed exact TIME-2.1 child and a finite external inventory with matching clock, span, count/root and terminal cutoff equal to the exclusive span end. It checks exact ordered retained rows and independent contradictions before absence reporting, preserving known child FAIL across typed replay unavailability.
files.limits: PASS establishes only the selected finite inventory closure under declared bounds. Continuous or real-world event coverage, authentic inventory/clock, wall-clock truth, causality, authority, complete TIME tier/profile conformance and full polish remain NOT_ESTABLISHED.

files.summary: Checks TIME-2.1 for one selected TIME record and typed collection: a nonempty committed sample sequence with unique identifiers and nondecreasing integer microsecond instants inside a nonempty half-open span on one labeled clock. Equal adjacent instants are admitted; missing samples or bounded checking unavailability yield UNKNOWN, while order/span/commitment contradictions yield FAIL. Source and resource replay unavailability now use the typed unavailable boundary rather than semantic refusal.
files.limits: PASS covers one declared clock and retained order only. Physical clock identity or calibration, cross-clock synchronization, actual causality, EVENT validity, elapsed physical duration, scheduling authority, privacy, consent, governance, security and whole-tier/profile conformance remain NOT_ESTABLISHED.

files.summary: Replays a TIME-2.1 child and checks that consecutive retained sample instants on the one declared clock are strictly increasing.
files.limits: Establishes only the registered proposition over externally selected finite inputs. Its registered exclusions include: causal arrow preservation or any EVENT-to-TIME binding; physical clock skew, clock identity, calibration or wall-clock truth; any relation between clocks; 3 further registered exclusions are listed in registration().

files.summary: Proposed current capability-token replay certificates, never authority grants: TOKEN-2.1 tenure (one declared birth, contiguous epoch folds, irreversible revocation, aging claims), TOKEN-3.1 windows (nonempty declared-clock windows, finite ones wider than the clock skew, unbounded ones reported) and TOKEN-4.1 delegation (a finite acyclic parent-grant path to the birth along which scopes, windows, invocation bounds, caveats and soulbound delegates do not widen). An exact externally selected TOKEN record in a finite typed collection, its retained native token inventory and per-predicate inputs replay under explicit, narrow mappings of retained legacy predicates. A contradiction is FAIL; missing inputs, or a TOKEN scope or clock unit without an admitted mapping, are UNKNOWN; a retained record of an unsupported kind never yields PASS. Importing the module registers nothing centrally.
files.limits: Excludes signatures, issuer authenticity, genesis opening, actual presentation or invocation consumption; physical clock calibration, status authenticity, financial balances or supply conservation; global holding completeness, legacy complete closure result, real-world authority or enforcement; unselected objectives, whole tier and object-profile conformance. The docstring states that signatures, physical validation and full qualification are not established. The certificate result reports authority, signature_validity, physical_clock, holding_completeness, actual_execution and object_profile_conformance as NOT_ESTABLISHED.

files.summary: Projects admitted TOKEN checks into the current-object obligation surface with exact route metadata.
files.limits: Projection does not establish exhaustive token behavior, security, applicability, or native PASS.

files.summary: Projects retained capability-token declarations (scope retained-capability-token-records, microsecond clock) into scoped semantic facets for the facet-derivation sidecar.
files.limits: Commitment anchors do not establish their retained contents or application completeness. Each semantic facet reports retained_contents_established as NOT_ESTABLISHED and application_semantic_completeness as UNKNOWN; the mapping reports full_application_facet_denominator as None, interaction_inventory_completeness and application_mapping_authority as UNKNOWN and production_profile_approval as NOT_ESTABLISHED.

files.summary: Reduces a TRAIN record's retained binary64 sequence along its retained addition order with round-to-nearest-even addition and requires the retained result exactly; the retained alternative order must be a different addition tree up to commutativity (operand order within an addition and the order of independent steps do not make a tree different) and the exact difference between the two reductions at most the retained bound.
files.limits: Establishes only the registered proposition over externally selected finite inputs. Its registered exclusions include: observation of the executing hardware's arithmetic (TRAIN-3.1); that the run executed the retained order: reproducing the retained result is consistent with that order, not proof of it; the effect of orders other than the two retained, and of reductions the record does not retain; 4 further registered exclusions are listed in registration().

files.summary: Binds the shared TRAIN-1.2, TRAIN-1.3, TRAIN-2.1, TRAIN-2.3 and TRAIN-4.1 mechanism digest to the direct source set, three normative standard documents and the exact local Python implementation, build, platform, pointer width, byte order and binary64 parameters.
files.limits: A changed dependency or runtime requires policy and certificate readmission for all five shared checks. The binding does not authenticate the interpreter, prove retained execution, establish cross-runtime equivalence, require the optional wrapper, or grant tier/profile/release credit.

files.summary: Replays exact selected TRAIN lineage and DATA inventory children and compares retained batch and shard records: coordinate TRAIN-1.5 needs the TRAIN-4.1 lineage child and the DATA-1.2 inventory child to reproduce exactly and pass, and the retained TRAIN batch view, which must be the data operand of the selected TRAIN subject and carry the selected digest, to equal the digest-keyed records of the selected DATA shards, with no unmatched batch entry, no unmatched shard record and no duplicate selected record; a selection with no records is UNKNOWN.
files.limits: It checks selected retained representations, not historical consumption. Registered exclusions: actual historical consumption, execution or observation; unretained records, DATA origin, rights or consent; MODEL weight derivation, whole TRAIN facets tier or polished issuance. Results carry object_profile_conformance and authority as NOT_ESTABLISHED.

files.summary: Checks selected declared structural facets and kind-specific operand requirements.
files.limits: Declared operand structure grants no real-world authority and is not full kind conformance.

files.summary: Projects typed-facet obligations into exact current-object routes for selected object kinds.
files.limits: Typed projection is not an exhaustive ontology, full application census, or correctness proof.

files.summary: Preserves exact versioned finite contract selection, portable assessment input identity and reviewed bounded host/native controls.
files.limits: Finite selected claims only. Full mandatory instance census/public checkability/composed security/complete corrigibility/acceptance remain UNKNOWN. Native10.1 is unimplemented. No runtime adoption or publication.

files.summary: Checks that a declared finite claim class equals the class enumerated from retained DAG profiles, that every member has a retained native decision replaying PASS with qualified PASS prerequisites, and that each class objective has declared counterexample-boundary cases replaying to their declared FAIL or UNKNOWN. The assessment of the whole retained DAG bundle must also reach PASS, a member needs direct and qualified status PASS with reason NATIVE_REPLAY, a VERIFIER-3.1 or VERIFIER-4.1 claim is refused inside its own class, a nested closure evaluation is UNKNOWN, and the member, DAG node and boundary-case ceilings are 512, 512 and 64.
files.limits: Establishes only the registered proposition over externally selected finite inputs. Its registered exclusions include: completeness beyond the declared finite class; authority or adequacy of the declared class or its profiles; class-wide soundness or correctness of any checker; 3 further registered exclusions are listed in registration().

files.summary: Adds bounded existing Ed25519 key screening and preserves independently observed invalid-signature FAIL across later backend errors, with exact helper/source bindings and consumer controls.
files.limits: Finite selected native replacement replay only. No full subgroup proof, key custody, production authority, whole corrigibility, mandatory census, trusted time, live revocation, human acceptance or promotion.

files.summary: Checks VERIFIER-3.1 through two traced in-process replays of one selected child certificate, requiring identical canonical reports, REPRODUCED replay and child PASS. Stops each tracer when it exceeds the minimum selected event allowance; a declared event-limit overrun yields FAIL, while checker-cap exhaustion before that limit yields UNKNOWN. Compares replay_report_bytes with declared maxima and binds constraint rows to the run digest. Displaced tracing, unavailable child or unobserved quantities yield UNKNOWN; determinate mismatches yield FAIL. Caller declarations are counted, with caller_declarations_admitted fixed at zero.
files.limits: Establishes only the registered proposition over externally selected finite inputs. Its registered exclusions include: execution-substrate identity, hardware, operating system or interpreter identity; physical resource constraints such as memory, time, energy or device use; process, sandbox, network or side-channel isolation; 3 further registered exclusions are listed in registration().

files.summary: Checks retained dataset inventory, schema, lineage, splits and overlap against declared shard commitments (digest, record count, byte count, per-record digests and Merkle root); a separate distribution function recomputes exact canonical-value class counts, rational balances and entropy under an independently selected finite tolerance. Lineage recomputes concat, project, filter_eq and deduplicate transformations; splits and overlap need complete, non-duplicated split membership with no record identity crossing a split, and overlap also bounds n-gram text overlap between a training and an evaluation split. The distribution tolerance is absolute, in bits, from 0 to 1e-9 inclusive, and each class balance is balance_numerator over balance_denominator.
files.limits: Retained statistics establish no external ancestry or population representativeness. Only the retained shards and their declared schemas, transformations, splits and distribution fields are covered; an unsupported field type or transformation leaves a check Unavailable.

files.summary: Checks retained ENV software inventory, configuration observations, resource ceilings and execution comparisons, only for the artifact scope retained-process-observations (any other scope is Unavailable). Any selector that is not exactly a str naming one of the four checks (a str subclass included) is Unavailable before evidence is read. Every check requires the retained files to match the artifact inventory by name and sha256; configuration needs the complete retained configuration to equal the required one; resources needs two or more distinct execution identities, each with wall_seconds, memory_bytes and threads inside its ceiling (wall_seconds compared unrounded); and reproduction needs two or more executions whose software, configuration, executable, input and output match the artifact and whose exit_code is 0. The helper collect_configuration returns six named observations.
files.limits: Retained observations, not physical attestation. Physical attestation and containment require an external qualified mechanism, and the collect_configuration collector is not independent evidence.

files.summary: Checks retained HARDWARE inventory, containment topology, interval allocations and integer measurement envelopes. Every check requires the artifact scope retained-hardware-records and digest-bound unique device records of known kinds whose capacities are integer quantities in known units; an unknown scope, kind or unit is Unavailable. Topology refutes duplicate, unresolved or cyclic containment edges; allocations (half-open nonempty intervals, summed where they overlap) and measurements may not exceed declared device capacity.
files.limits: Never physical attestation: the result reports physical_authenticity, live_availability and credit_authority as NOT_ESTABLISHED, and physical hardware claims require a separately qualified observation mechanism.

files.summary: Partitions HARNESS observation channels into instrumented and declared-gap sets and checks messages, tool calls, effects and transcript commitments. An unsupported check selector, a str subclass included, is Unavailable before evidence is read. For every check except surface, each retained transcript record must have an exact-int index equal to its position, a role of user, agent or tool, an instrumented channel and its payload digest, and record_count must be an exact int equal to the number of records; the transcript check also compares transcript_digest and transcript_root. The tools check needs a registered tool and binds each invocation to its declaration digest and a retained tool record; the effects check refutes an effect on a declared-gap or undeclared effect channel, an effect whose index is not an exact int naming a retained record, and a duplicate effect.
files.limits: The certificate covers the instrumented observation surface, not the actor. Declared gaps are named, never absent; an undeclared channel is not a gap. The effects check compares neither the channel nor the payload of an effect with the retained record that its index names.

files.summary: Binds a HUMAN assertion's metadata (evidence class biometric, hardware-attested, in-person or social-graph; capture pipeline; enrollment population; validity interval; name, nationality and civil_identity left explicitly unasserted) and its retained evidence records by digest. The lifecycle check replays contiguous, time-ordered enrollment, reverification, compromise, revocation and death events, beginning with enrollment at the validity start, and returns a result only while the declared state is DECLARED_ACTIVE; a withdrawn or ended assertion is Unavailable, and so is the closure check.
files.limits: No declaration authenticates a living person; these checks bind metadata and replay a declared event order and do not certify personhood, witness independence, biometric performance, or numbered profiles. The assertion result reports personhood and witness_independence as NOT_ESTABLISHED; the lifecycle result reports physical_liveness as NOT_ESTABLISHED and current_time as NOT_OBSERVED. The liveness_claim and uniqueness_claim values are only type-checked as booleans.

files.summary: Binds IDENTITY bearer, role and occupancy records, replays lifecycle events and conditionally rechecks child certificates. The binding needs a HUMAN or BOT bearer, an explicit ROLE coordinate and an assurance_level of declared (any other nonempty text is Unavailable). Lifecycle replay needs contiguous events beginning with an enrollment at the declared validity start and is Unavailable when the binding ends inactive. The support check also needs a checker-selected policy and mechanism digest, treats a HUMAN bearer as Unavailable, and replays the BOT and ROLE child certificates through bind_certificate.
files.limits: Retained-record consistency is separate from bearer authenticity, role authority and a numbered-profile claim. The occupancy and support checks report bearer_authenticity, role_authority, occupancy_authority and occupancy_evidence_ref_resolution as NOT_ESTABLISHED, the lifecycle check reports the first two as NOT_ESTABLISHED, and a retained HUMAN declaration cannot establish living bearer authenticity.

files.summary: Defines the retained domain applicability and objective inventory over 234 kind-tier slots.
files.limits: The retained native inventory is distinct from extensible consequence kinds and is not a passing result.

files.summary: Builds and rechecks request-bound mainstay certificates with policy and implementation binding. build_mainstay_certificate runs the requested checks of one mainstay under one shared checker-controlled budget, records PASS, UNKNOWN or FAIL per check (overall FAIL over UNKNOWN over PASS), and raises Refuted for evidence that differs from the request or a policy whose mechanism digest differs from mainstay_implementation_digest (pinning this envelope, carrier mechanisms and interpreter version). A MODEL roundtrip tolerance above the policy max_tolerance (at most 1e-8) leaves that check UNKNOWN. recheck_mainstay_certificate requires an exact rebuild under the consumer request and policy and returns the result, or a REJECTED record on ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, ArithmeticError or RecursionError. mainstay_runtime_catalog returns mainstay_catalog output plus mechanism_digest, runtime_support and a scope string.
files.limits: These certificates establish only the selected bounded checks; they do not establish a complete domain tier, object profile, native-format conformance, observation authenticity or an external trust root. The built result reports object_profile_conformance, domain_tier_5_conformance, native_format_conformance and authentication as NOT_ESTABLISHED, and a REJECTED record reports all of these except native_format_conformance. The runtime catalog scope states that registry membership alone does not establish support.

files.summary: Registers 50 named mainstay formats across 11 objects (DATA, ENV, BENCH, TRAIN, TOKEN, HYPER, MODEL, SIM, HARNESS, AGENT, BOT) as Mainstay records, each with a residual of the owning object's obligations below profile 5 that the format does not express, and defines 23 CHECKS exposed as mainstay:<name> in mainstay_catalog. evaluate rejects an unsupported check, or an object with no registry, as Unavailable and an unregistered format_id as Refuted; it requires a version and a canonical sha256 carrier_digest, inspects the retained carrier with carriers.inspect_carrier and requires its digest to equal the bound one. binding returns the carrier facts, roundtrip delegates to carriers.roundtrip, residual requires the recomputed residual to equal the declared one, and every other check delegates to carriers.mapping. mainstay_digest pins the catalog and the source bytes of this mechanism family.
files.limits: The registry describes format vocabulary and catalogue residuals and does not establish format support. Executable admission currently covers Hypertext Transfer Protocol Archive (HAR) 1.2 transcripts and finite binary32/binary64 safetensors weights under the v0.5.3 format-description snapshot; unsupported formats and unimplemented semantic checks raise Unavailable rather than validating labels. No record establishes authenticity, observation completeness or whole-profile conformance, and residuals describe the catalogue, not proof of every expressed facet. The binding result reports native_format_conformance and authentication as NOT_ESTABLISHED.

files.summary: Replays retained MODEL evidence under five named checks: artifacts, tensors, inference, evaluation and challenges; any other name, or one that is not exactly a str, is Unavailable. Every check requires the architecture and weights to match architecture_digest and weights_digest and the retained dependencies to match the declared dependency digests. tensors builds the dense network and returns its layer count. inference and evaluation require unique sample ids and a sample list matching samples_digest, and recompute each sample output within the artifact tolerance; evaluation also recomputes mean_squared_error, mean_absolute_error or accuracy (another metric is Unavailable), compares it with metric_value and requires it inside metric_bounds. challenges evaluates each finite probe condition over the output values. Metric thresholds are compared at their exact parsed values, not rounded.
files.limits: The file defines no exclusion list. It delegates numerical admission to number(), rejects negative tolerance locally and imposes no tighter local tolerance ceiling. Metrics are limited to mean_squared_error, mean_absolute_error and accuracy; other names are Unavailable. Challenge checks cover the retained finite probe list, and no branch establishes how the architecture, weights, samples or declared dependencies were produced.

files.summary: Implements shape-checked dense layers with linear/ReLU activation, forward computation, mean-squared-error backpropagation with ReLU derivative zero at zero, optimizer configuration and one SGD/Adam/AdamW update under a constant schedule. Each update computes gradient norm and clips when it exceeds max_grad_norm. The python-binary64 path iterates lists and uses Python built-in sum for forward dot products, loss, propagated derivatives and gradient norm. Unsupported arithmetic, activation, optimizer or schedule raises Unavailable; shape or optimizer-state contradictions raise Refuted.
files.limits: Only the selected python-binary64, linear/ReLU, SGD/Adam/AdamW and constant-schedule subset is implemented. Built-in sum is used without a fixed reduction tree or cross-Python byte-equivalence guarantee. No accelerator arithmetic or physical-hardware equivalence is established.

files.summary: Checks OWNER consequence limbs, lifecycle events, verdict independence and a declared accountability chain. Declared held verdicts and holder labels leave independence and the accountability floor UNKNOWN; lifecycle events require their declared instruments, and a lapse declared as an event is refuted.
files.limits: A declared verdict is not a replayed one, so verdict independence stays open until the held object's own certificate is replayed. The accountability floor is never closed here: every answering-duty chain must end in a natural person, which only a HUMAN certificate can establish and no adapter issues, so a holder label never stands in for one.

files.summary: Checks a ROLE class declaration and replays retained occupancy events. The facets check requires role_class_id and coordinate as nonempty text, authority and qualifications as name lists without duplicates, a bearer_limit of at least 1 and a nonempty admissible_bearer_classes list drawn only from human and bot, and reports counts. The occupancy check binds the occupancy_events list to occupancy_events_digest and replays contiguous take, leave and paired handover events, refuting a take by a seated bearer or of an inadmissible class, a leave without a take, an unpaired handover, a handover that takes an inadmissible class, an unsupported event kind and any count above bearer_limit, then requires current_occupants to equal the replayed occupants. Every check validates the class declaration first; any other check name is then Unavailable.
files.limits: ROLE is a class, never a bearer or an authorization decision, and the adapter checks declared records only: it does not authenticate people, qualifications or grants. The occupancy result reports declared_occupants_after_trace with live_occupancy as NOT_ESTABLISHED and occupant_classes_declared_only as True.

files.summary: Replays finite SIM transitions and checks invariant expressions, refinement projections, channels and shard relations. A check selector that is not exactly replay, invariants, refinement, channels or shards (str subclasses too) is Unavailable before evidence is read. Every check binds trajectory, entropy stream and causal times to their digests, requires the declared initial state and increasing times, and recomputes each transition. When finite_state_set is declared, invariants also requires the trace to stay in it, every member to satisfy the invariants and the set to be transition-closed over finite_entropy_set. refinement compares macro projections within the artifact tolerance. When require_signatures is true, shards also verifies an Ed25519 signature per row under the witness key of its shard (an absent key is Unavailable, a bad one refuted); an unrequested signature is refuted.
files.limits: State variables and causal time have the units of the supplied model contract. Without finite_state_set the invariants are checked only along the retained trajectory; with it they are also checked on every declared member and transition closure is checked only over the declared finite_entropy_set. Signatures bind retained observations to checker-selected keys, not independence; an absent witness key is Unavailable and an unrequested signature is refuted.

files.summary: Registers and executes named tier-3 statics checks across selected domain objects: 41 checks over seven objects (DATA 6, TRAIN 5, TOKEN 14, HYPER 5, HARNESS 4, AGENT 3, BOT 4), each exposed as statics:<name> and of kind witness, recompute or invariance. A witness check needs a retained probe record whose observer differs from the subject and whose measurement matches its digest, then checks the measurement for consistency; a machine-dependent measurement is recorded, never passed. A recompute check recomputes a statistic over the retained inventory and compares it with the declaration. An invariance check re-decides the earlier statics of the object under subject-supplied alternative choices and refutes if any verdict moves. statics_catalog and statics_digest describe and pin the mechanism.
files.limits: Witness identity and independence are not established by different observer strings; the witness routines check supplied measurement consistency, and admitting an external observation requires a separate qualified mechanism. A statics check establishes only its own named proposition over the retained records, and statics_catalog implies no dependency chain between checks.

files.summary: Replays a retained TOKEN holding under the selected check: tenure, leases, signatures or closure, with any other value returning the inventory report. The holding is bound by tokens_digest and must descend from exactly one birth token, otherwise the result is Unavailable. The tenure check refolds contiguous epoch statuses from the birth commitment against the aging tokens; leases resolves parent grants to the birth token and refutes widened scopes, windows, invocation bounds or caveats and re-delegated soulbound leases; signatures verifies Ed25519 signatures only under issuing keys the checker admitted, an unadmitted key being Unavailable; closure resolves audience, lease windows against clock skew and status freshness against a published schedule.
files.limits: A verified signature binds a token to an issuing key the checker admitted and says which key issued the token, never that anything the token names is authorized. A retained status is evidence about the instant it was published, not a later one. The genesis secret, the salt and the opening of the birth commitment are never required: the commitment seeds the tenure fold and is not opened here.

files.summary: Replays retained TRAIN evidence under five named checks: configuration, checkpoints, training, updates and lineage; any other name, or one that is not exactly a str, is Unavailable before evidence is read. Every check validates the configuration through numerical.configuration. checkpoints compares digest(checkpoint) for each retained checkpoint value with the declared checkpoint_digests and the weights of each checkpoint to the architecture. The other three also match steps to steps_digest and require a contiguous trajectory (step index, parent and result checkpoint digests, configuration digest, optimizer step, batch digest, every retained batch referenced). training also recomputes the loss and gradients of each step from its equal-sized microbatches, whose count must equal accumulation; training and updates recompute the optimizer weights and state within the artifact tolerance.
files.limits: The file registers no exclusion list. It calls number() for retained artifact tolerance and rejects negative tolerance locally. Unequal-sized microbatch accumulation is Unavailable. Only training recomputes gradients from batches; updates uses retained gradients and lineage recomputes no loss, gradient or optimizer update. Microbatch averaging uses Python built-in sum. No check establishes how the initial retained checkpoint or batches were produced.

files.summary: Checks VERIFIER identity, soundness, determinism, resources and meta. Retained proofs are limited to cnf_sat unit-propagation certificates, and soundness refutes unbounded proposition classes. Determinism needs at least two runs with distinct ids, identical input, software and output digests and zero entropy leakage, and, after evaluating soundness, recomputes each run output by native proof replay. The resources check can only refute or end Unavailable on caller measurements; its one passing route is a resource_execution request delegated to verifier_execution. The meta check needs a PASS bootstrap receipt and a SELF_VERIFIED or PASS self-attestation, each bound by digest, plus a matching toolchain digest (mismatches are Refuted); a schema_version verifier-native-bootstrap-1 receipt goes to verifier_bootstrap and then to a retained proof replay, any other receipt is Unavailable.
files.limits: Finite native proof replay concerns retained formula/encoding-rule instances; class_wide_soundness, producer_execution, universal_determinism and entropy_freedom remain NOT_ESTABLISHED. No submitted code executes. Caller measurements cannot PASS the resources branch; only resource_execution delegates to verifier_execution.evaluate_resources. Unsupported bootstrap labels remain unavailable, and binding bounds describe kernel work, clauses and bytes rather than wall-time or process-memory guarantees.

files.summary: Independently recomputes finite Boolean bootstrap evidence under an externally admitted exact-scope signing key. The receipt must carry the schema verifier-native-bootstrap-1, status PASS and an oracle_digest equal to the digest of the source bytes of this module; its own digest must equal the artifact bootstrap_digest, and its verifier_id, toolchain_digest and soundness_claims_digest must match the artifact. Each cnf_sat claim is decided by exhaustive truth-table evaluation over at most twelve Boolean variables and must agree with the native certificate verdict PASS or FAIL. Only afterwards is the Ed25519 signature checked against a checker-selected witness key, so a finite contradiction is refuted even when no key is admitted; an absent key is Unavailable and an inadmissible key or bad signature is refuted.
files.limits: Neither the externally configured key nor the exhaustive truth-table result establishes general verifier soundness, organizational independence or external factual truth; SHA-256 binds bytes, not authority. The result reports general_verifier_soundness, organizational_independence and external_facts as NOT_ESTABLISHED.

files.summary: Keeps the fixed Windows Job Object replay bounds and bounded pre-mutation retry for transient assigned/included membership disagreement. It retires only absent signaled members, requires CloseHandle success before deletion/accounting, and requires the authoritative lifetime aggregate not to regress below the observed retired-plus-retained subset.
files.limits: Successful cleanup requires job termination, zero active accounting and a signal for every retained handle. Point-in-time membership is not a complete lifetime process-identity census, which remains NOT_ESTABLISHED. Windows CPython remains the only implemented process capability; this is not a general sandbox, cross-platform qualification or verifier-soundness proof.

files.summary: Re-export facade for the experimental environments package: importing it loads the contracts, assessment and integration submodules and exposes 23 names from them (13 from contracts, 4 from assessment, 6 from integration), all listed in __all__. The module docstring says direct namespace imports are experimental, not supported top-level exports, and that inspection and transport never execute submitted environment implementations.
files.limits: The file defines no logic of its own and checks nothing: the statement that inspection and transport never execute submitted environment implementations is docstring text here, the names are experimental rather than supported top-level exports, and no conformance claim is made.

files.summary: Assesses an environment record without executing it (assess_environment, environment_evidence_refs) and, on explicit request, evaluates one retained run through an existing VerificationSession and its exactly registered mechanisms (evaluate_environment_run). The assessment checks mode support, connections, capabilities, retained path and byte bindings (missing bytes INDETERMINATE, contradictions FALSIFIED) and instance, run, workload, evaluator, model, input-boundary and input-alias bindings. A proposition reaches the session only if the binding preflight is established, it binds this exact run and complete evidence set, matches the bound evaluator mechanism, predicate and implementation digest, repeats no predicate and, for a capability predicate, names a declared capability; otherwise it is INDETERMINATE and the checker is not invoked.
files.limits: Inspection never executes an environment. Neither operation establishes numbered-profile conformance or authenticates that an execution occurred; findings cover declared connections, exact byte bindings and explicitly checked propositions only, and enforcement, real-world validity and actor independence also stay NOT_ESTABLISHED. A success covers neither component semantics nor the completeness of the modeled boundary, and a registered checker is a named trust boundary, not an independent witness or an environment execution engine.

files.summary: Defines eight experimental environment record types (definition, component, connection, instance, mechanism, run binding, model-interaction binding and artifact binding) as JSON records that bind exact bytes with SHA-256, and the role and capability string vocabularies they carry, with load_environment_record and artifact_bindings.
files.limits: The records declare boundaries only: no runtime enforcement, correctness, independence or satisfaction of a numbered profile. Only the definition, instance and run binding carry a schema identifier and load through load_environment_record.

files.summary: Projects environment records into nonexecuting packages, a registry, artifact relations, a verification surface and workload commitments by reusing existing catalog, geometry and artifact-relation contracts (package_environment, unpack_environment, environment_registry, environment_relations, environment_surface, bind_environment_workload).
files.limits: No projection supplies a verdict or execution permission; packages retain exact bytes and nothing here runs submitted environment code.

files.summary: Provides MixedSuiteMechanism with no producer-module import or submitted-byte execution. Checks digest-selected JSON environment/run/instance fixtures and their public/evaluator input partition, then recomputes exact indexed recall and tokenizer/request/response bindings, satisfaction of a retained finite Boolean assignment, or bounded ±1 counter transitions, termination and optional restoration suffix. Requires exact evaluator/measurement reports; unknown family or missing recall model interaction gives UNKNOWN, malformed or contradictory fixtures FAIL. The docstring describes the fixture checkers as independently written.
files.limits: The fixtures demonstrate environment contracts only: not model performance, physical simulation validity or independent actors.

files.summary: Builds runnable synthetic environment specimens (CounterEnvironment, ReferenceRecallModel, build_specimen, specimen_bindings and a main entry point) as JSON fixtures that exercise the record, package and checker contracts.
files.limits: The specimens use a scripted reference model, not learned-model inference or a capability benchmark. Counter states are integer counts, recall distances are fixture symbols rather than model tokens, and no independent witness is claimed.

files.summary: Evaluates exact-action governance admission against independent keyed roots, policy, clock and signed status. Captures bounded plain candidate evidence, caller context, trusted policy and principal values before authentication and use; snapshots carried receipts before replay serialization. Authenticated denial, revocation, consumed invocation, quorum and principal-key checks cannot be changed by later caller mutation. Exact builtin admission types reject custom iteration, equality, length and membership behavior before checking.
files.limits: Admission is relative to separately provisioned secret roots: any holder of those keys can create that evidence. A passing receipt is not an execution permit and not legal authority; jurisdictions are exact policy scopes, not legal conclusions. The caller must separately enforce privacy, consent and atomic invocation consumption: the receipt sets privacy and consent to NOT_EVALUATED and enforcement to UNKNOWN. The minimum key length is a shape check, not an entropy proof. The computational_verdict argument is echoed into the receipt and does not affect the verdict. A mutation during capture can change the captured declaration, but signature verification then applies to those exact bytes.

files.summary: Re-exports software diode-emulator and temporal-comb models and the experimental artifact-tracing types beside existing accelerator-accountability types.
files.limits: Import availability does not provide physical isolation or hardware attestation.

files.summary: Discovers selected AMD management interfaces and normalizes offline hardware evidence.
files.limits: Discovery and normalized offline data do not attest device state or independent trust.

files.summary: Discovers selected NVIDIA management interfaces and normalizes offline hardware evidence.
files.limits: Discovery and normalized offline data do not attest device state or independent trust.

files.summary: Provides SoftwareOneWayDataDiodeEmulator: push writes and flushes bytes to an optional BytesIO sink and counts messages/bytes; a closed push raises ContainmentViolationError, while read, recv and peek raise SeveredChannelReadViolationError. Emitted receipts default to is_software_emulation=True, hardware_attestation_valid=False and maximum_admissible_tier='TIER_1_LOCAL'. Receipt construction rejects falsey software markers, truthy hardware-valid markers and unequal tier values without exact Boolean type checks. The disclaimer digest is stored without comparison to disclaimer text, and a conversion attempt returns a dictionary labeled with SOFTWARE_EMULATOR:<id>.
files.limits: Software development/testing/interface rehearsal only. The local disclaimer excludes physical unidirectional optical isolation, severed electromagnetic/timing side channels and guaranteed containment against high-capability models or kernel exploits. No native hardware attestation or downstream containment admission is established by this module.

files.summary: Models the firmware-accountability contract in an executable reference emulator.
files.limits: Emulated behavior is not evidence that physical hardware executed or is secure.

files.summary: Changes VSTD3Receipt validation to require the VSTD-3 schema identifier.
files.limits: Receipts labeled VSTD-3.0 are not accepted by this exact validation branch.

files.summary: Changes the standard label in common_software from VSTD-3.0 to VSTD-3. attach_vstd3_receipt passes that mapping as software_provenance at each of its nine TransformationHyperedge constructions; the implementation label vstd is unchanged.
files.limits: The label alone does not establish a device's physical identity or independent provenance.

files.summary: Changes the VSTD-3 receipt recognizer to match the VSTD-3 schema identifier.
files.limits: The recognizer does not rewrite or validate older VSTD-3.0 records.

files.summary: Respells the const value that the generated receipt schema requires for the schema_version field of VSTD3Receipt, from VSTD-3.0 to VSTD-3, in the _field_schema method of _SchemaBuilder; no other line of the file changes.
files.limits: The generated schema description states that unknown dataclass fields are rejected and that semantic and cryptographic verification is additionally required, so a schema-valid receipt is not thereby verified.

files.summary: Defines temporal-comb grid quantization via round(timestamp/spacing), pulse-offset comparison and cadence analysis. Comparison guards reject nonpositive spacing, spacing above 1,000,000 ns, nonpositive jitter and jitter at/above half-spacing. Cadence requires at least two increasing supplied timestamps, checks each pulse and computes jitter statistics plus normalized eight-bin offset entropy. It flags only exactly two distinct tooth-step values over at least twelve timestamps. Attestations check firmware digest spelling; the software emulator sets is_hardware_anchored=False.
files.limits: All comb/timestamp/hardware-anchor declarations are caller supplied; no physical comb is measured and the base comb defaults its hardware marker to True. Exact numeric types and finiteness are not checked, so the comparison guards alone do not establish valid positive finite inputs. entropy_threshold_bits is stored but unused. The docstring's rejection by physical containment tiers is not implemented here.

files.summary: Provides a coordinate builder from a validated VSTD-3 receipt execution and reachable hardware records, plus experimental detached tracing over a supplied coordinate. issue_artifact_trace obtains exactly 32 bytes from an injected EntropyProvider, embeds them through TraceCarrier, requires exact re-extraction, and HMAC-SHA256 binds marker, final bytes digest/size, coordinate, carrier/provider/key identifiers and limitations under a key of at least 32 bytes. verify returns UNKNOWN for unavailable/invalid marker or key resolution, MISMATCH for failed MAC or carrier/coordinate/size/digest differences, otherwise MATCH; only MATCH recommends NONE, all other statuses QUARANTINE_FOR_REVIEW.
files.limits: A provider identifier and 32-byte marker shape do not establish entropy, freshness or uniqueness. This module authenticates a detached binding relative to its key; it does not identify an actor, conceal an artifact or establish information-theoretic security. PROHIBITED_INFERENCE excludes natural-person identification, authorship, malicious intent, guilt, correctness, authorization and absence of untraced artifacts. DEFAULT_LIMITATIONS names removable/copyable/damageable carriers, inherited receipt trust boundaries and computational HMAC authentication.

files.summary: Removes ActorBinding from this identity package's imported token names and __all__, while retaining BirthToken, AgingToken, LifetimeToken and token serialization/commitment helpers.
files.limits: This file is a re-export facade; it implements no replacement actor binding or composition behavior.

files.summary: Respells the three token schema identifiers from VSTD-BIRTH-TOKEN-1, VSTD-AGING-TOKEN-1 and VSTD-LIFETIME-TOKEN-1 to verifier-birth-token-1, verifier-aging-token-1 and verifier-lifetime-token-1, in the constants BIRTH_TOKEN_SCHEMA, AGING_TOKEN_SCHEMA and LIFETIME_TOKEN_SCHEMA and in the Literal type of schema_version in BirthToken, AgingToken and LifetimeToken, and deletes the actor binding dataclass with its schema constant VSTD-ACTOR-BINDING-1; the other definitions are unchanged.

files.summary: Adds explicit package-v2 structural capacity for512 artifacts and512 implementation source paths; preserves default package-v1 and other256-item/byte bounds.
files.limits: Stored-byte shape/identity only; no native correctness, independence, dependency closure, full polish, authority or promotion.

files.summary: Provides publish_sim_artifact, which POSTs the exact bytes of a bare SIM artifact file to the /v1/artifacts route of a ClaimGarden endpoint, with publisher_id as a query parameter and a bearer token from credential_file. Before any request, among other checks, the file sha256 must equal expected_source_digest, the certification request must equal expected_request, recheck_domain_certificate must return status PASS under policy, the model transition and initial_state must equal the certified ones, and publisher_id must be publisher:sha256: plus 64 lowercase hex digits. A transport or response-check failure, including a response that does not bind the quarantined source, returns result INDETERMINATE with state UNKNOWN; otherwise the result is SUBMITTED or REJECTED_AUTOMATIC. Every returned result carries publication NOT_ESTABLISHED. read_sim_artifact and read_intent_object read bounded strict JSON.
files.limits: Local replay binds only the retained native certificate and model core. The host performs its own admission and human review; this client never reports hosting. A successful response proves only quarantine at the returned source digest. Once transport was called, storage may have succeeded despite a lost or forged response.

files.summary: Respells the three schema identifiers of the experimental finite authority composition (DECLARATION_SCHEMA, RESULT_SCHEMA, PROFILE_SCHEMA) from VSTD-FINITE-AUTHORITY-COMPOSITION-0.1 (and its -RESULT-0.1 and -PROFILE-0.1 forms) to verifier-finite-authority-composition-1 (and its -result-1 and -profile-1 forms); no other line of the file changes. RESULT_SCHEMA is stamped into every assessment result and all three values are part of the compiled rule bytes, so authority_composition_profile_digest changes. A declaration carrying an old schema_version is not migrated: it is an unsupported input, and the assessment returns reason code INPUT_UNAVAILABLE_UNSUPPORTED_OR_LIMITED with coordinate_binding, transition_correspondence, agency_preservation and local_addition_preservation all left UNKNOWN.
files.limits: Identifier changes alone add no authorization semantics or independent authority evidence. The file checks declared transitions only, not runtime execution, enabled permissions, source grounding or general agency, and it leaves eight residual obligations unestablished or unperformed (for example RUNTIME_MODEL_CORRESPONDENCE_NOT_ESTABLISHED and SOURCE_GROUNDING_NOT_ESTABLISHED).

files.summary: Respells the five schema identifiers of the experimental bounded-completeness sidecar (DECLARATION_SCHEMA, DENOMINATOR_SCHEMA, OBSERVATIONS_SCHEMA, RECEIPT_SCHEMA, MECHANISM_PROFILE_SCHEMA) from VSTD-BOUNDED-COMPLETENESS-0.1 (and its -DENOMINATOR-0.1, -OBSERVATIONS-0.1, -RECEIPT-0.1 and -MECHANISM-PROFILE-0.1 forms) to verifier-bounded-completeness-1 (and its -denominator-1, -observations-1, -receipt-1 and -mechanism-profile-1 forms); no other line of the file changes. The declaration, denominator, observations and receipt decoders each accept only their one new value, so a declaration or receipt with an old label raises BoundedCompletenessError and an old-label denominator or observations record makes the assessment INVALID; nothing is migrated. mechanism_profile_digest and the checker coordinate change because MECHANISM_PROFILE_SCHEMA is part of the profile bytes.
files.limits: Establishes only disposition completeness relative to one exact, externally source-grounded finite denominator. It does not establish an absolute universe, logical decidability, semantic truth, producer independence, or completeness outside the declared profile. Receipts carry five residual obligations: ABSOLUTE_UNIVERSE_NOT_ESTABLISHED, DENOMINATOR_AUTHORITY_NOT_ESTABLISHED, GENERAL_LOGICAL_DECIDABILITY_NOT_ESTABLISHED, GENERAL_SEMANTIC_COMPLETENESS_NOT_ESTABLISHED and PRODUCER_INDEPENDENCE_NOT_ESTABLISHED.

files.summary: Respells CATALOG_SCHEMA_VERSION from VSTD-INTEROPERABILITY-CATALOG-1.1 to verifier-interoperability-catalog-2 and _LEGACY_CATALOG_SCHEMA_VERSION from VSTD-INTEROPERABILITY-CATALOG-1.0 to verifier-interoperability-catalog-1; no other line of the file changes. InteroperabilityComponentRegistry.from_dict accepts only these two values: the current one requires every descriptor to carry planning_surface_schema_ids, the legacy one forbids it and is decoded under the current schema_version, and any other value, including the old VSTD forms, raises CatalogError.
files.limits: Registry membership describes an exact declared capability. It does not run a component, establish availability, validate a native result, or grant assurance. Domain tags are discovery metadata only and never participate in matching. AWARENESS_CLAIM_BOUNDARY, defined here for other modules, states: Permission does not establish artifact awareness; withholding direct access does not establish non-inferability. This operation does not establish confidentiality of awareness.

files.summary: Adds publish_claim: accepts a VERIFIED label selected by truthy fallback, requires a positive declared integer count or a nonempty retained statement/reason/clause list, and requires claim_digest to match canonical claim bytes. When canonical_digest is present, only the VSTD-1 claim_mechanics branch recomputes its stable payload; an optional notary_binding receives truthy signature/key-presence checks. Uses publisher bearer credentials for one claim-storage submission, then requires STORED/PENDING_REVIEW, HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED, exact claim/retrieval bindings, consistent deduplication and positive returned metrics. The shared base-URL validator rejects raw whitespace/control characters before parsing.
files.limits: Preflight checks carried labels, counts and digests without native proof replay or notary signature authentication; optional canonical_digest is not compared for other receipt schemas. The accepted storage response leaves publication NOT_ESTABLISHED and requires human review. It establishes neither claim correctness, real-world publisher identity nor acceptance; server response fields are not authenticated server signatures.

files.summary: Respells COMPONENT_INDEX_SCHEMA_VERSION from VSTD-COMPONENT-INDEX-1 to verifier-component-index-1; no other line of the file changes. StoredComponentIndex accepts only this schema_version, in its constructor and in from_dict (any other value, including the old VSTD form, raises ComponentIndexError), and writes it from to_dict and into the search_exact result.
files.limits: Index membership and digest integrity do not establish publisher identity, license authenticity, implementation correctness, availability, ecosystem completeness, native-platform qualification, or authorization (INDEX_CLAIM_BOUNDARY also lists dependency completeness). A match establishes only that a descriptor in this exact index declares the queried capability. Loading and searching never fetch, import, install, or execute a package. Zero matches do not establish ecosystem absence.

files.summary: Respells ANALYSIS_SCHEMA_VERSION from VSTD-SURFACE-ANALYSIS-1.0 to verifier-surface-analysis-1 and PLAN_SCHEMA_VERSION from VSTD-VALIDATION-PLAN-EXPERIMENTAL-0.1 to verifier-validation-plan-experimental-1; no other line of the file changes. SurfaceAnalysis and ValidationPlan each require exactly their own new value as schema_version (SurfaceAnalysisError otherwise) and write it from to_dict.
files.limits: The analyzer derives diagnostics only from geometry already represented by the caller. It does not infer an expected profile, omitted ontology, or real-world completeness, and ANALYSIS_CLAIM_BOUNDARY also says it does not establish that the declared surface, coordinates, ontology, or evidence are complete. A catalog match is a candidate association, not a verification result and not authority to execute a component. Exact catalog matches do not establish availability, validity, assurance, authority, or closure. Registry-only plans identify declarations, not implementation payloads.

files.summary: Respells three schema constants of the experimental deriver self-status sidecar: DECLARATION_SCHEMA from VSTD-DERIVER-SELF-STATUS-0.1 to verifier-deriver-self-status-1 (the module docstring gets the same respelling), RECEIPT_SCHEMA from VSTD-DERIVER-SELF-STATUS-RECEIPT-0.1 to verifier-deriver-self-status-receipt-1, and CHECKER_SCHEMA from VSTD-DERIVER-SELF-STATUS-CHECKER-0.1 to verifier-deriver-self-status-checker-1; no other line of the file changes. DeriverSessionDeclaration and DeriverSessionReceipt each accept only their own new schema_version (DeriverSelfStatusError otherwise), and CHECKER_SCHEMA is part of the bytes returned by checker_profile_bytes, so checker_profile_digest changes. RUNNER_ID is unchanged.
files.limits: ESTABLISHED does not establish structural self_derivability, source semantics, global behavior, completeness, safety, authorization, sandboxing, or another runtime. The sidecar discharges no numbered VSTD-4 rung and never upgrades or relabels the retained structural self_derivability axis. SHA-256 binds retained bytes and canonical JSON records; it does not prove their meaning. The runner bounds elapsed time and combined captured output, but it is not a sandbox and does not bound processor or memory consumption. Confidential environments are unsupported.

files.summary: Respells EXECUTION_READINESS_SCHEMA_VERSION from VSTD-EXECUTION-READINESS-EXPERIMENTAL-0.1 to verifier-execution-readiness-experimental-1; no other line of the file changes. ExecutionReadinessReport requires exactly this value as schema_version (ExecutionReadinessError otherwise) and writes it from to_dict.
files.limits: READY means only caller-supplied declarations are internally complete and consistent with exact analysis, plan, registry and required stored package. No component executes, native input/result validation, authority, safety, closure or post-execution reassessment is established. AUTHORIZED remains caller supplied, not independently established authority.

files.summary: Respells the schema_version literal of the source-identity inventory hashed by _implementation_digest from VSTD-TYPED-FORMATION-SOURCE-IDENTITY-0.1 to verifier-typed-formation-source-identity-1; no other line of the file changes. FormationPathCertificateMechanism takes its mechanism_digest from _implementation_digest, and evaluate returns an UNKNOWN decision with reason FORMATION_IMPLEMENTATION_UNSUPPORTED when the mechanism_id or mechanism_digest of the binding differs from its own, so mechanism_digest changes with the literal.
files.limits: The mechanism coordinate is selected source-file identity, not loaded-code, full dependency, execution provenance or independent attestation. A PASS means only that the named finite formation certificate checks under its declared context. Ground and authority axiom agency roots are assumption labels, not proofs of grounding or authority. All source-level residual obligations remain. Evaluation does not read files, execute uploaded code, import a producer or promote silo statuses. Finite checker budgets are not a general process sandbox.

files.summary: Respells the schema_version values required of a formation selection and a formation receipt: SELECTION_SCHEMA from VSTD-SILO-FORMATION-SELECTION-0.1 to verifier-silo-formation-selection-1 and RECEIPT_SCHEMA from VSTD-SILO-FORMATION-RECEIPT-0.1 to verifier-silo-formation-receipt-1; no other line of the file changes. The module decodes a canonical JSON formation selection (commit digest plus four portable paths, at most 4096 bytes) and a receipt (at most 1048576 bytes), builds a receipt by capturing at most 256 evidence objects and freshly inspecting the selected bytes with inspect_silo_formation, and recheck_formation_receipt returns the fresh inspection only when the whole receipt is reproduced.
files.limits: Reproduction is not a passing verdict, execution provenance, source self-derivation, completeness or authority axiom agency preservation. The interface neither retrieves artifacts nor executes code. Admitting a selection establishes not its existence, roles or authority, and decoding a receipt checks exact carried grammar only: recomputation remains a separate gate.

files.summary: Respells PROFILE_SCHEMA from VSTD-TYPED-FORMATION-PROFILE-0.1 to verifier-typed-formation-profile-1; no other line of the file changes. inspect_silo_formation compares the artifact_kind, declared_schema_id and media_type of the selected subject, certificate and profile census records with _ROLES (for the profile: typed-formation-profile, PROFILE_SCHEMA, application/json); a different triple is reported as SELECTED_ROLE_DECLARATION_INVALID and makes coordinate_binding INVALID.
files.limits: This local inspection is not a portable receipt or a silo assessment: exact census retention, declared context binding, and fresh finite formation checking remain separate. No source interpretation, ground origin, completeness, agency action preservation, execution, or existing silo axis is established here. BOUND is not a formation verdict, COMPLETE is not silo completeness, and agency MATCHED is never action preservation. Retained observations are not an atomic concurrent-storage snapshot.

files.summary: Respells three schema literals: SUBJECT_SCHEMA from VSTD-TYPED-FORMATION-0.1 to verifier-typed-formation-1, CERTIFICATE_SCHEMA from VSTD-TYPED-FORMATION-CERTIFICATE-0.1 to verifier-typed-formation-certificate-1, and the schema_version literal inside the compiled profile bytes from VSTD-TYPED-FORMATION-PROFILE-0.1 to verifier-typed-formation-profile-1; no other line of the file changes. decode_subject and decode_certificate admit only their own new value (another schema_version string raises UnsupportedFormation, a missing or non-string one raises FormationError), and all three literals are part of profile_bytes, so profile_digest changes.
files.limits: This module shares only grammar, byte identity and fixed resource declarations; it contains no type inference or certificate acceptance algorithm. decode_subject admits finite syntax only; decode_certificate admits proof-step syntax, not a producer verdict or type assertion. Context digests name declared ground and authority axiom agency, not evidence that either has been established. RESIDUAL_OBLIGATIONS: SOURCE_INTERPRETATION_NOT_ESTABLISHED; GROUND_DERIVATION_NOT_ESTABLISHED; SOURCE_TRACE_RELATION_NOT_ESTABLISHED; SOURCE_LAYER_BOUNDARY_NOT_ESTABLISHED; SELF_STATUS_NOT_ESTABLISHED; GLOBAL_CYCLE_NOT_ESTABLISHED; COMPLETENESS_NOT_ESTABLISHED; AGENCY_NOT_CHECKED.

files.summary: Prepares and submits gated Claim Garden evidence. Locally, prepare_gated_publication projects a rechecked gate receipt into a minimized report (project_gate_receipt, evidence class UNAUTHENTICATED_LOCAL_REPORT), requires the input inventory to bind the artifact, request, certificate and policy bytes, requires the native certificate recheck to PASS, enforces byte limits, and refuses components containing a local path or recognized secret pattern. publish_gated runs an account preflight and makes one HTTPS submission for human review, only with explicit private-review consent and a publisher credential file; get_publish_account and the account command read linkage, byte quota and host coordinates. A dry run prepares locally, optionally writing a new output file, with no credential read or transport. handle_gated_publish_command returns 0 on success, 2 for an UNKNOWN outcome and 1 otherwise.
files.limits: The minimized gate report does not authenticate execution, identity, permission, or its original receipt. Native domain replay and human review are separate, and even a stored submission reports publication as NOT_ESTABLISHED.

files.summary: Respells CONFLICT_REPORT_SCHEMA_VERSION from VSTD-GEOMETRY-CONFLICTS-EXPERIMENTAL-0.1 to verifier-geometry-conflicts-experimental-1; no other line of the file changes. GeometryConflictReport uses the constant as the default of its schema_version field and writes it from to_dict; the file contains no check that rejects a different value.
files.limits: This diagnostic covers only the supplied geometry bytes, explicit shared-proposition bindings, and declared acyclic dependencies. It does not infer translation equivalence, omitted obligations, evidence validity, physical truth, safety, authority, conformance, or permission to execute a component. The module never infers that similarly named coordinates are equivalent, never executes a verifier, and never treats graph consistency as physical truth.

files.summary: Defines experimental geometry-bound Boolean constraints over explicitly declared propositions. prepare_geometry_constraints binds one to four canonical geometries, up to 128 shared-proposition bindings and named CNF clauses (at most MAX_VARIABLES 32 propositions, MAX_CLAUSES 128 clauses and MAX_LITERALS 1024 literals) into a GeometryConstraintProblem with a canonical_digest. solve_geometry_constraints runs a bounded DPLL producer and returns SAT with a named model, UNSAT with a VSTD4-RUP-1 certificate, or UNKNOWN when the work estimate exceeds MAX_SEARCH_WORK 8_000_000 or the search stops, then rechecks its own witness. recheck_geometry_constraints checks a given model or certificate against a separately supplied problem digest without calling the producer, raises ValueError for a mismatched or unaccepted witness, and returns UNKNOWN beyond the max_check_work or max_proof_steps bounds.
files.limits: No geometry judgment, name or topological edge becomes a truth literal. SAT and checked UNSAT concern only the supplied finite formula, never geometry closure, physical truth, authorization, independence or numbered conformance. UNKNOWN carries no witness and does not prove why a previous search stopped. Hard admission caps and conservative work estimates bound this local calculation; they are not wall-clock timeouts or a sandbox.

files.summary: Respells three schema constants of the experimental global-cycle sidecar: DECLARATION_SCHEMA from VSTD-GLOBAL-CYCLE-ASSESSMENT-0.1 to verifier-global-cycle-assessment-1, RECEIPT_SCHEMA from VSTD-GLOBAL-CYCLE-ASSESSMENT-RECEIPT-0.1 to verifier-global-cycle-assessment-receipt-1, and SEMANTICS_SCHEMA from VSTD-CYCLE-RELATION-SEMANTICS-0.1 to verifier-cycle-relation-semantics-1; no other line of the file changes. GlobalCycleDeclaration.from_dict accepts only the new DECLARATION_SCHEMA and the semantic-source decoder only the new SEMANTICS_SCHEMA (GlobalCycleError otherwise); assess_global_cycles writes RECEIPT_SCHEMA as the schema_version of the receipt it builds, and recheck_global_cycle_receipt raises GlobalCycleError unless the supplied receipt bytes equal the rebuilt bytes.
files.limits: No result establishes truth, causation, correctness, completeness, provenance admission, or trust. An explicitly declared backward-time relation is a statement about a declared coordinate equation, not evidence of physical retrocausation. The receipt lists nine residual obligations: CAUSATION_NOT_ESTABLISHED; COMPLETENESS_NOT_ESTABLISHED; CORRECTNESS_NOT_ESTABLISHED; DENOMINATOR_AUTHORITY_NOT_ESTABLISHED; HISTORICAL_EXECUTION_NOT_ESTABLISHED; ISSUER_IDENTITY_NOT_ESTABLISHED; PHYSICAL_RETROCAUSATION_NOT_ESTABLISHED; SIGNATURE_AUTHENTICITY_NOT_ESTABLISHED; TRUTH_NOT_ESTABLISHED.

files.summary: Interprets exact recorded graph topology under explicit logical-time and numeric bounds.
files.limits: Recorded graph interpretation does not admit a profile or prove real-world causality.

files.summary: Against pinned same-path base f06414feec801c8b44a662d583ddff817ce22a1b, changes 20 schema/version literals to verifier-prefixed -1 forms while retaining the mechanism_id values, and centralizes six unchanged silo-assessment result vocabularies. SiloCommit checks relation type/count before ordering, rejects duplicate canonical relation bytes, and orders by relation_type, source_path, target_path and canonical record bytes. Head, both continuity-key and directory-snapshot verification calls admit_ed25519_public_key before the optional cryptographic backend verifies the signatures; ValueError and InvalidSignature become NetworkError.
files.limits: Old schema/version strings are not admitted aliases. Assessments cover exact retained bytes, declared formation paths, the explicit census denominator and declared finite authority models/actions; they do not establish artifact correctness, real-world publisher identity or permission to execute retained bytes. Derivational coverage, semantic coverage and logical decidability remain UNKNOWN in assess_silo. The named file delegates public-key admission and cryptographic verification; static reading of these calls establishes neither the imported admission algorithm nor observed verification success.

files.summary: Respells five schema identifiers of the finite-set proposition transfer from upper-case VSTD forms ending in 0.1 to lower-case verifier forms ending in -1: TRANSFER_SCHEMA, ASSESSMENT_SCHEMA, RECEIPT_SCHEMA and ARTIFACT_SCHEMA, and the rule schema_version written inside rule_profile_bytes; no other line of the file changes. decode_transfer and decode_transfer_receipt raise PropositionTransferError for any other schema_version, and assess_transfer reports predicate_result INVALID for a retained artifact record with another schema_version under the supported predicate, so nothing is migrated. rule_profile_bytes embeds both the rule schema_version and ARTIFACT_SCHEMA, so the SHA-256 digest of the rule profile bytes changes.

files.summary: Respells the native version, native input, native output, accepted schema and emitted schema identifiers of the registry from upper-case VSTD forms to lower-case verifier-prefixed forms ending in -1 and shortens VSTD-3.0 to VSTD-3; the VSTD-1, VSTD-2, VSTD-4 and VSTD-5 identifiers and the SCITT interoperability identifier are unchanged. It also sets REFERENCE_CATALOG_VERSION to verifier-reference-components-1, replaces eight pinned profile digests and two profile paths, renames three component labels and two native object labels to GRAPH forms, and updates specification and schema paths quoted in two transformation-loss texts.
files.limits: Catalog membership does not execute a component, prove runtime availability, establish native input validity or grant a VSTD result, and registry construction never imports or executes an implementation entry point.

files.summary: Respells the four schema identifiers of the experimental relation-boundary replay, DECLARATION_SCHEMA, EVIDENCE_SCHEMA, RECEIPT_SCHEMA and MECHANISM_PROFILE_SCHEMA, from VSTD-RELATION-BOUNDARY-0.1 (and its -EVIDENCE-0.1, -RECEIPT-0.1 and -MECHANISM-PROFILE-0.1 forms) to verifier-relation-boundary-1 (and its -evidence-1, -receipt-1 and -mechanism-profile-1 forms); no other line of the file changes. The declaration, evidence and receipt decoders each compare schema_version with the one new value and raise RelationBoundaryError otherwise, so nothing is migrated. relation_boundary_mechanism_profile_digest and the checker coordinate change because MECHANISM_PROFILE_SCHEMA is part of the profile bytes.
files.limits: The registered mechanism compares declared facets in exact source and target proposition bytes; a receipt exposes preserved and lost information and never upgrades a bounded map to semantic equivalence, completeness, authority or general translation correctness. Every receipt carries six residual obligations: AUTHORITY_NOT_ESTABLISHED, COMPLETENESS_NOT_ESTABLISHED, GENERAL_TRANSLATION_NOT_ESTABLISHED, HISTORICAL_EXECUTION_NOT_ESTABLISHED, PRODUCER_INDEPENDENCE_NOT_ESTABLISHED and RUNTIME_CORRESPONDENCE_NOT_ESTABLISHED.

files.summary: Respells five constants: DECLARATION_SCHEMA, RECEIPT_SCHEMA and PROFILE_SCHEMA from VSTD-RUNTIME-AUTHORITY-CORRESPONDENCE-0.1 (and its -RECEIPT-0.1 and -PROFILE-0.1 forms) to verifier-runtime-authority-correspondence-1 (and its -receipt-1 and -profile-1 forms), TRACE_SCHEMA from VSTD-RUNTIME-AUTHORITY-TRACE-0.1 to verifier-runtime-authority-trace-1, and SUPPORTED_RUNTIME_KIND from VSTD-RETAINED-EVENT-TRACE-REPLAY-0.1 to verifier-retained-event-trace-replay-1; no other line of the file changes. Record decoding accepts only the new schema_version values (another string raises RuntimeAuthorityUnsupported, a missing or non-string one RuntimeAuthorityInvalid); an unsupported declaration gets reason code DECLARATION_UNSUPPORTED in the built receipt. All five values are part of the profile bytes, so runtime_authority_profile_digest changes; a runtime_kind mismatch gives reason code RUNTIME_KIND_UNSUPPORTED.
files.limits: The bounded replay checks only observed transitions and coverage of an explicit finite denominator. It does not prove unobserved runtime behavior, actor identity, authorization, sandboxing, secrecy, actual deployment, deployment continuity, artifact truth, correctness, safety, or another runtime coordinate.

files.summary: Implements the locally documented -00 Derived Subjects mapping: eight-byte big-endian lengths encode context, content and unique scoped identifiers sorted by encoded octets; SHA-256 hashes the length-prefixed domain separator plus binding bytes and produces the pinned base64url subject prefix. JSON and optional deterministic CBOR decoding rejects duplicate or unordered identifiers and enforces byte/count caps. Subject comparison returns NOT_ESTABLISHED for another prefix, a falsey semantics_established value or a different revision; a malformed matching prefix raises DerivedSubjectError. VstdDerivedSubjectBinding separately hashes claim, subject, predicate, parameters and role-specific artifact digests, plus a distinct evidence-bounds digest.
files.limits: The file documents an experimental individual draft pinned to -00 and prohibits silent reuse for later revisions. Semantic subject grouping alone does not bind a complete VSTD claim coordinate or validate its computational result; the explicit VSTD binding retains the separate claim and evidence-bound digests. Missing binding or a different draft/mapping version returns NOT_ESTABLISHED.

files.summary: Adds loss-preserving adapters (consume_composite_result, consume_coverage_reconciliation, consume_transformation_evidence) for the result vocabularies of pinned experimental SCITT evidence drafts, and local_vstd_condition, which maps five VSTD-side condition names (revoked, superseded, budget-exhausted, not-established, falsified) onto the same EvidenceCondition enumeration; every SCITT-derived result retains computational_verdict=NOT_EVALUATED.
files.limits: Non-normative: only the pinned drafts' result vocabularies are consumed, and none of their complete graph, disclosure or reconciliation protocols is implemented. local_vstd_condition consumes no SCITT vocabulary; it keeps VSTD-side causes distinct for crosswalks.

files.summary: Prepares one exact builtin bytes.sha256 proposition for an INDETERMINATE geometry coordinate, rejecting stale or substituted geometry, context, registry, plan, descriptor and optional retained source. Execution snapshots the canonical request and selected evidence, requires separately configured exact-byte DigestHostPolicy approval, maps PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN to VERIFIED/FALSIFIED/INDETERMINATE for that coordinate and reassesses the entire geometry. Replay reruns under separately supplied host approval and requires equality of the complete retained record.
files.limits: SHA-256 equality checks byte identity, not general correctness; no VSTD-4 rung is discharged. Host approval is reusable in-process policy with no expiry, revocation or hostile-host isolation; evidence bounds limit counts/bytes, not time. Expected-digest provenance is not established, and no package, plugin, network or filesystem input is executed.

files.limits: The sidecar does not infer grounding from a declaration, certificate authorship, or a claimed verdict. Producer independence, historical execution, completeness, authority, and runtime correspondence remain explicitly unestablished; the receipt lists five residual obligations: AUTHORITY_NOT_ESTABLISHED; COMPLETENESS_NOT_ESTABLISHED; HISTORICAL_EXECUTION_NOT_ESTABLISHED; PRODUCER_INDEPENDENCE_NOT_ESTABLISHED; RUNTIME_CORRESPONDENCE_NOT_ESTABLISHED.

files.summary: Respells COMPONENT_PACKAGE_SCHEMA_VERSION from VSTD-COMPONENT-PACKAGE-1 to verifier-component-package-1; no other line of the file changes. files.limits: Stored component packages carry no numbered-profile verdict. A digest identifies canonical package content, not its publisher, implementation correctness, dependency completeness, or permission to execute. Package integrity binds retained bytes and declarations only. Publisher and license are unsigned declarations. Implementation correctness, dependency completeness, runtime availability, native-platform qualification, authorship, and authorization are NOT_ESTABLISHED. Loading never imports an entry point, extracts, fetches, or installs; import and planning execute nothing. AWARENESS_CLAIM_BOUNDARY is appended to the claim boundary.

files.summary: Respells UNTRAVERSABLE_SCHEMA_VERSION from VSTD-UNTRAVERSABLE-EXPERIMENTAL-0.1 to verifier-untraversable-experimental-1 and UNTRAVERSABLE_REPORT_SCHEMA_VERSION from VSTD-UNTRAVERSABLE-REPORT-EXPERIMENTAL-0.1 to verifier-untraversable-report-experimental-1; no other line of the file changes.
